title: Noura compiled-lesson blueprint quality rubric
description: Fixed offline rubric for Phase 5 blueprint quality scoring. Live strong-model judging is not implemented.

dimensions.label: Stage purpose
dimensions.criteria: Each stage has a distinct objective aligned with its boardPurpose and learnerOpportunity; stages progress orient → model → check without duplicate purpose.

dimensions.label: Check/task pairing
dimensions.criteria: Guided and independent check stages include at least one check with child-facing questionOrTask wording; voice checks avoid manipulate-only tasks on non-manipulate stages.

dimensions.label: Visual intent vs geometry authorship
dimensions.criteria: Board-led lessons declare an anchor with template or raw ops intent; establish stage uses allowedBoardMutation establish; geometry remains compiler/director authored, not realtime-invented.

dimensions.label: Manipulate-check pairing
dimensions.criteria: Every responseMode manipulate check includes a manipulativeCheck spec; non-manipulate checks must not claim machine-checked drag/tap without the spec.

dimensions.label: No assessment targets in generated images
dimensions.criteria: Illustration or image intents must not encode answer targets, measured scales, or equations that belong in exact BoardOp overlays.
